Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 16, "heading": "CHAPTER 14. MY AUNT MAKES UP HER MIND ABOUT ME", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u016-b0030", "target": "— Это очень странно, — сказал мистер Дик, удручённо глядя на свои бумаги и снова запустив руку в волосы, — что я никак не могу довести это как следует. Никак не могу сделать это совершенно ясным. Но неважно, неважно! — сказал он весело, встряхнувшись. — Времени достаточно! Передай мой поклон мисс Тротвуд, скажи, что у меня всё идёт очень хорошо.", "source_sha256": "335ea7f82f34c53efc7da5574617d716d5d56c0091021a91a5231d1562d1fea5", "target_id": "ru-en85-u016-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1ba48fead61f7240eeb698c60c48aa7ee925d1c228183fb8fce332b20249f129"}, {"source_id": "en85-u016-b0031", "target": "Я уже собирался уходить, когда он обратил моё внимание на змея.", "source_sha256": "66f36400ea2d108494c98c868ddf9f49bb26b843a2e83415f165745173595d81", "target_id": "ru-en85-u016-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7c4f727e1803f97acf4b13018f8983ea8da23612fe3f3ab9c26f8b4c9aed1ed1"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 14, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u016-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What do you think of that for a kite?’ he said.", "sha256": "3b194bac03a4d59ea1ffe19288877dd47c2416fb4b76ee9c6dba932cf91bd43b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I answered that it was a beautiful one. I should think it must have been as much as seven feet high.", "sha256": "e0c124460b461938874d4922cee5d32c8c28c32db21b5173862a34b3a998ea53", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I made it. We’ll go and fly it, you and I,’ said Mr. Dick. ‘Do you see this?’", "sha256": "2bb25e9ce1c107ddca3f305d17bbeb6569865ed9da32e8e467a54b4bda87e270", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He showed me that it was covered with manuscript, very closely and laboriously written; but so plainly, that as I looked along the lines, I thought I saw some allusion to King Charles the First’s head again, in one or two places.", "sha256": "1b3830a9b890a5a81b94dee1ae88b75b3c59cf2939d0efad444c03ccfe9b4b15", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There’s plenty of string,’ said Mr. Dick, ‘and when it flies high, it takes the facts a long way. That’s my manner of diffusing ‘em. I don’t know where they may come down. It’s according to circumstances, and the wind, and so forth; but I take my chance of that.’", "sha256": "d3ceea9b3d0c6a17652f759325d571d14e6a07b322b64d82b10ace17e41edcb3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "His face was so very mild and pleasant, and had something so reverend in it, though it was hale and hearty, that I was not sure but that he was having a good-humoured jest with me. So I laughed, and he laughed, and we parted the best friends possible.", "sha256": "a98eea805111af439a82ed112ed2cf005d77b5f758b7723477470a17396cbf92", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, child,’ said my aunt, when I went downstairs. ‘And what of Mr. Dick, this morning?’", "sha256": "44d81ca29d47618d1097d4e300ba8d8c9425edd095e7c75ef7caf9184c84ffe0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I informed her that he sent his compliments, and was getting on very well indeed.", "sha256": "48fb528a88ac0b670cde301686ee9d3e198b2b51a0cafd60c8f149dd867eb4dc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What do you think of him?’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "1877ea2bae3da922b2d1586c5288b5ad9a6a5c4e33f630d0729576293889085d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I had some shadowy idea of endeavouring to evade the question, by replying that I thought him a very nice gentleman; but my aunt was not to be so put off, for she laid her work down in her lap, and said, folding her hands upon it:", "sha256": "aaf3f7abd1b6006fba10d1e65d431d14a2e66dda07f3c170d68252dda2bea4da", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Come! Your sister Betsey Trotwood would have told me what she thought of anyone, directly. Be as like your sister as you can, and speak out!’", "sha256": "637ca96e746663847a644418e34134314156cf1c62dd54a002adad087e345817", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is he—is Mr. Dick—I ask because I don’t know, aunt—is he at all out of his mind, then?’ I stammered; for I felt I was on dangerous ground.", "sha256": "8880608af309464e148619ddcc9328f0102dffa93ab1dbd3c0c315e9a047ecb5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not a morsel,’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "d5b9660bc47ad1f11d6d718195bf9a62e10245ba5e44292607e961f5aaf21c29", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, indeed!’ I observed faintly.", "sha256": "92652950f4a65c4c04ba466ae443646a0c44a7d237ae3b4b2ae32b42bb47c859", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If there is anything in the world,’ said my aunt, with great decision and force of manner, ‘that Mr. Dick is not, it’s that.’", "sha256": "d90848f95bc9d9379ecff148fb28cdc00d09fbeadf13de3af7d88338a70da138", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I had nothing better to offer, than another timid, ‘Oh, indeed!’", "sha256": "699b96b110fcd879c997abd43a4eb67c00de336f81922ec4daf6db29fcf21272", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He has been CALLED mad,’ said my aunt. ‘I have a selfish pleasure in saying he has been called mad, or I should not have had the benefit of his society and advice for these last ten years and upwards—in fact, ever since your sister, Betsey Trotwood, disappointed me.’", "sha256": "15c69b88f92a648a9edd4cae7da3e083997e09f06ff447a16d0307ba35096f9e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘So long as that?’ I said.", "sha256": "37e797de9c6bd8dd7a19acc97bb96613677601585d248da346dd0968a53bfbe3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And nice people they were, who had the audacity to call him mad,’ pursued my aunt. ‘Mr. Dick is a sort of distant connexion of mine—it doesn’t matter how; I needn’t enter into that. If it hadn’t been for me, his own brother would have shut him up for life. That’s all.’", "sha256": "b07972d80c8f86a82aa96535b11f8eb9aca6269e0f1693f10d8e4a16483b7d49", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I am afraid it was hypocritical in me, but seeing that my aunt felt strongly on the subject, I tried to look as if I felt strongly too.", "sha256": "f5d1d99494fb3c9a2c74be82b5b3ce27fde0fb89cef87cdd5ccbbc7a193b2d2b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A proud fool!’ said my aunt. ‘Because his brother was a little eccentric—though he is not half so eccentric as a good many people—he didn’t like to have him visible about his house, and sent him away to some private asylum-place: though he had been left to his particular care by their deceased father, who thought him almost a natural. And a wise man he must have been to think so! Mad himself, no doubt.’", "sha256": "f6cb25b354d5a31f48e05f78b42e0a0b2a6db78eb7e0d22cb425fa1111f886d7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Again, as my aunt looked quite convinced, I endeavoured to look quite convinced also.", "sha256": "2d47380d00e2d60b5bdecc0676aebdcf2ff302f27fbf40eff71f7a3b7e92a352", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘So I stepped in,’ said my aunt, ‘and made him an offer. I said, “Your brother’s sane—a great deal more sane than you are, or ever will be, it is to be hoped. Let him have his little income, and come and live with me. I am not afraid of him, I am not proud, I am ready to take care of him, and shall not ill-treat him as some people (besides the asylum-folks) have done.” After a good deal of squabbling,’ said my aunt, ‘I got him; and he has been here ever since. He is the most friendly and amenable creature in existence; and as for advice!—But nobody knows what that man’s mind is, except myself.’", "sha256": "867cbccb1df6bf8c12cf8aaaa0cecb614049549d6c34b5b89b1d6d544571aa09", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt smoothed her dress and shook her head, as if she smoothed defiance of the whole world out of the one, and shook it out of the other.", "sha256": "7e8204d5673bcded76d58b82ed069f31379e0c90218bee6b29b4fd43d66e392a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He had a favourite sister,’ said my aunt, ‘a good creature, and very kind to him. But she did what they all do—took a husband. And HE did what they all do—made her wretched. It had such an effect upon the mind of Mr. Dick (that’s not madness, I hope!) that, combined with his fear of his brother, and his sense of his unkindness, it threw him into a fever. That was before he came to me, but the recollection of it is oppressive to him even now. Did he say anything to you about King Charles the First, child?’", "sha256": "b389046d485a1d7b01843063a5b327f63325944aed0d62858ba5b77266262c55", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, aunt.’", "sha256": "4271e43366663b20b66f84d52e4663c27ec244c1068ae6ecc0a00ad0b7db4634", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ah!’ said my aunt, rubbing her nose as if she were a little vexed. ‘That’s his allegorical way of expressing it. He connects his illness with great disturbance and agitation, naturally, and that’s the figure, or the simile, or whatever it’s called, which he chooses to use. And why shouldn’t he, if he thinks proper!’", "sha256": "f01665a2a26a20748b2d11f4a3d2da3ed0da80c2faa05bee499ea5155fd647ca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I said: ‘Certainly, aunt.’", "sha256": "3d451f48eaefc8d89fd1462a00efaa19fdaa9b18a0b1757ecce241adec6fccac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s not a business-like way of speaking,’ said my aunt, ‘nor a worldly way. I am aware of that; and that’s the reason why I insist upon it, that there shan’t be a word about it in his Memorial.’", "sha256": "3d1a3598bea305e7da21626a5ff5a0a27de76d6ccee7311a422f6b488a5e79ac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is it a Memorial about his own history that he is writing, aunt?’", "sha256": "a3a447af6153b8b22348f8e73cacbbb3c11a187f3b25a8a8ea3f075cf9c0928b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, child,’ said my aunt, rubbing her nose again. ‘He is memorializing the Lord Chancellor, or the Lord Somebody or other—one of those people, at all events, who are paid to be memorialized—about his affairs. I suppose it will go in, one of these days. He hasn’t been able to draw it up yet, without introducing that mode of expressing himself; but it don’t signify; it keeps him employed.’", "sha256": "480bbcff90def4f0a2085b5f965a93abfe1c1b343403e11789925c0adc9ea5b7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u016-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In fact, I found out afterwards that Mr. Dick had been for upwards of ten years endeavouring to keep King Charles the First out of the Memorial; but he had been constantly getting into it, and was there now.", "sha256": "29c0a0270cda73f059336336e353c6f2e73f955c2d9164824a2d4b67a40dc7c6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[21]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
